```{r}
library(ape)
library(dplyr)
data(carnivora)
```



```{r}
x <- c(1:8, NA, 10)
```

```{r}
(
  d <- carnivora %>%
    select(SuperFamily, SW) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    group_by(SuperFamily) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), v = var(SW), xbar = mean(SW))
)
```

## Example

```{r}
alpha <- 0.05
xbarC <- d$xbar[1]
xbarF <- d$xbar[2]
diff <- (xbarC - xbarF)
# difference of means
nC <- d$n[1]
nF <- d$n[2]
vC <- d$v[1]
vF <- d$v[2]
t.star <- qt(1 - alpha / 2, df = min(c(nC, nF) - 1))
se <- sqrt(vC / nC + vF / nF)
ME <- t.star * se
(ci <- c(diff - ME, diff + ME))
```
